title: The trees, close
logline: The first trees of the ridge close enough to touch, bark filling the page's sides, the path between them narrowing, the glow between the trunks ahead a slot of ochre. The page is a doorway.

panels.composition: Two cedar trunks filling the page's left and right edges with a narrow path between them and, far ahead between the trunks, a slot of warm ochre light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, two cedar trunks filling the page's left and right edges with a narrow path between them and far ahead a slot of warm ochre light between the trees, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
